name: labs/nominal-io__instro
title: Siglent SPD3303 series power supply (instro.psu.drivers.siglent_spd3303.SiglentSPD3303)
intro: Siglent SPD3303 series power supply (instro.psu.drivers.siglent_spd3303.SiglentSPD3303), adapted from nominal-io/instro. It reads `voltage_ch1`, `current_ch1`, `regulation_mode_ch1`, `voltage_ch2` and 3 more; sets `voltage_setpoint_ch1`, `current_setpoint_ch1`, `output_enabled_ch1`, `voltage_setpoint_ch2` and 2 more; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: disable both channel outputs (OUTP CH1,OFF and OUTP CH2,OFF); it takes no input and is the declared safe state. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/nominal-io__instro --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/nominal-io__instro --backend fake --mcp
